says: Scene 5: a scout leaps the gap between two floating islands, from the big rock cropped at the lower left toward a domed lookout on the island at upper right, with smaller islands, misty cliffs and a glider far below. Carrying the notes forward: I built her from one arched gesture line running from the trailing foot through the spine to the reaching hand, and let the limbs hang off it. Every contour now changes weight with the light, thin and sometimes open on the lit upper-left side, heavy where it turns into shadow. Folds and joints get one line each, and I am leaving more white.
